description: Returns a full multi-domain underwriting report for a project or site, covering substation headroom, queue status, nodal power prices, equipment lead times, and capital commitments. Pass any project name, alias, canonical ID, or candidate site location.

include_8760_profile.description: Include 8,760-hour annual load profile summary metrics.

include_all_domains.description: Include physical siting, queue status, nodal pricing, and capital stack sections.

include_equipment_lead_times.description: Include high-voltage transformer lead times and schedule slippage estimates.

include_nodal_basis.description: Include pricing node LMP basis spread and transmission congestion metrics.

include_pnode_bus.description: Include ISO pricing node and electrical settlement bus resolution.

location.description: Greenfield candidate site city, county, or market (e.g. 'Columbus, OH', 'Ashburn, VA').

perspective.description: Diligence perspective used to weight risks (e.g. 'investor', 'lender', 'developer').

power_factor.description: Assumed AC power factor between 0.70 and 1.00 (e.g. 0.95).

project.description: Project name, alias, canonical project ID, Map project ID, queue ID, or developer plus place (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Hyperion', 'AXP-US-LA-00003', 'QTS Atlanta').

project_id.description: Project ID, canonical ID, or URL slug (e.g. 'P017', 'CVP0003', 'hyperion-richland-parish').

query.description: Project name, alias, or underwriting query (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene' or 'Hyperion Richland Parish').

site.description: Project name, site name, city, county, or canonical ID (e.g. 'Stargate Abilene', 'Columbus, OH', 'Loudoun County, VA').

target_mw.description: Target IT or facility electrical load in megawatts (e.g. 300).

workload_archetype.description: Compute workload archetype for 8,760 load factor modeling (e.g. 'FRONTIER_AI_TRAINING').

name: underwrite_large_load_asset

next_useful_tools.description: Suggested follow-up MCP tools relevant to this result.

status.description: Execution status (OK, SUCCESS, RESOLVED, AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY, NOT_FOUND, ERROR).

using_project.description: Banner confirming the resolved project name, city, state, and canonical ID when a project was matched.
